## Story DD Coverage
- dd-3: Integration test against throwaway DIG — marker update inserted post-pass-start; differ emits exactly one mutation; marker picked up on next pass

## Testing Mode
RED

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] Integration test exists in tests/integration/dso_reconciler/
  Verify: test -f tests/integration/dso_reconciler/test_fetcher_throwaway_dig.py
- [ ] Test has env-var-based skip marker
  Verify: grep -E 'pytest.skip|skipif.*JIRA' tests/integration/dso_reconciler/test_fetcher_throwaway_dig.py
- [ ] Test asserts exactly one marker mutation tuple
  Verify: grep -E 'exactly one|== 1|len\(.*mutations.*\) == 1' tests/integration/dso_reconciler/test_fetcher_throwaway_dig.py
- [ ] Test collects across two passes for round-trip
  Verify: grep -E 'second_snapshot|next_pass|collect\(.*\).*collect\(' tests/integration/dso_reconciler/test_fetcher_throwaway_dig.py

## TDD Test Spec
Given a throwaway DIG project reachable via JIRA env vars and a fetch pass in flight; When a marker issue update is inserted post-pass-start and a subsequent collect() runs; Then the differ comparing the two snapshots emits exactly one mutation tuple for the marker issue.

## Implementation Notes
- Create tests/integration/dso_reconciler/test_fetcher_throwaway_dig.py
- pytest.skip when JIRA_API_TOKEN / JIRA_BASE_URL / JIRA_PROJECT env vars absent
- Sequence: pass 1 snapshot → insert marker on throwaway DIG → pass 2 snapshot → differ.compute_mutations(snap1, snap2) emits exactly one tuple for the marker

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: RED integration: throwaway-DIG marker round-trip
